typography.headings: font-sans (Outfit, Cabinet Grotesk, or system geometric sans). Should feel structural, heavy, and clean.
typography.body: Inter or IBM Plex Sans for a technical, readable feel.
rules: Headings should use tight tracking: tracking-tight
Body text should have loose line height: leading-relaxed
No generic centered layouts for content. Left-align lists and cards.
Hierarchy gap rule: Jump between a heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps. H1 (text-5xl) -> Subtitle (text-xl or text-2xl max).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm on cards, and shadow-md on hover. No heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders on cards (border-slate-200). Crisp edges, rounded-md or rounded-lg radius.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid heavy gradients. Use solid colors.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky header, use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90. DO NOT use completely transparent background.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-md), and border color change.

components.name: Header
components.description: Sticky top, white background with border-b. Logo on left, nav links and primary CTA on right. Must not have a transparent background.

components.name: Hero Section
components.description: Large search bar, left-aligned or centered, clear 'Find Jobs' and 'Find Tenders' quick links below search.

components.name: Job/Tender Card
components.description: Clean white card, 1px border. Shows Title, Company/Org, Location, Last Date, and ID. View button.

components.name: Verified Source Badge
components.description: Small pill-shaped badge, light green bg with dark green text and a check icon.

components.name: Search Bar
components.description: Large input field, prominent submit button. Prominent placeholder text. Use Shadcn Input.

components.name: Filters Sidebar/Top bar
components.description: Simple select dropdowns for State, City, Category. Use Shadcn Select.

grids_and_layouts.container: Max width 1200px (max-w-6xl mx-auto), generous padding px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.
grids_and_layouts.listings: CSS Grid: 1 column on mobile, 2 or 3 columns on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.details_page: Two-column layout on desktop: Main content (8 cols) and Sidebar (4 cols) for Apply CTA/Summary.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use generous spacing (p-6 or p-8 inside cards, gap-6 or gap-8 between elements).

motion.hover: Transition transform and shadow on cards. Exclude transforms from universal transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on inputs and buttons (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels on icon buttons and search inputs.

images.description: Hero section background image (if needed). Must be used with a heavy light overlay (bg-white/80) or dark overlay (bg-slate-900/80) to maintain text contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React frontend (.js files) with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI primitives.
Strictly follow the color palette. Industrial Blue (slate-900) for text, Safety Orange (orange-600) for primary CTAs.
Ensure the application is mobile-responsive. Hide complex filters in a drawer on mobile if necessary.
Seed realistic sample data for Jobs and Tenders (Indian context, e.g., L&T, NHAI, Shapoorji Pallonji).
Implement the listing cards with a clean, border-only look (no heavy shadows).
Ensure navigation matches requirements: Jobs, Tenders, Submit Requirement.
Create the hidden admin route with simple CRUD for jobs and tenders.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You have .js files not .tsx file, so use JSX in .js files.
Do not use generic centered layouts for everything. Left-align text for readability.
Create depth with borders, subtle shadows, and layout hierarchy rather than gradients.
Never apply transition: all. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors).
Do not center-align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Use modern pill-shaped or slightly rounded buttons (rounded-md or rounded-lg).
Avoid emoji icons. Use Lucide icons.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6, gap-8) to avoid cramped designs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
